name: AAG Ubuntu Diagnostics
description: Diagnoses the current Ubuntu host from natural-language troubleshooting goals. Semantically choose one trusted profile; for genuinely combined incidents choose one optional secondary profile. Start vague whole-system incidents with general_system and refine from evidence. Preserve conversational targets only when they validate against the structured fields. This tool is read-only and never accepts commands, binaries, shell, systemctl actions, or mutation requests.
author: AAG

profile.description: Required trusted profile: general_system, performance, service, application_start, network, storage_mount, docker, package, or boot_health. Select by semantic troubleshooting intent, never by literal phrase matching.

secondary_profile.description: Optional second trusted profile for a genuinely multi-domain request. Must differ from profile. Leave empty for one domain.

manager.description: Optional manager, exactly system or user.

path.description: Required safe diagnostic path for storage_mount.

container.description: Optional validated container name for docker.

package.description: Required validated Debian package name for package.

routing.action: inspect current live Ubuntu system state and diagnose host resource problems
routing.operation: audit CPU memory disk processes services logs or devices
aliases: חקור עומס מעבד זיכרון או דיסק
routing.excludes: ordinary content creation or an image that merely depicts Ubuntu, a terminal, laptop, or computer
